NFL DFS Quarterback Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 3:08 PM ET

Brock Purdy is the top-projected quarterback on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 22.6 DraftKings points for $7,000, at Dallas. Josh Allen (22.2, $7,500) and Tyler Shough (19.4, $5,600) are next.

Drew Lock returns the most per dollar among quarterbacks projected for at least 15 points: 3.46 projected points per $1,000 at $5,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 3:08 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Quarterbacks to know in Week 10

Brock Purdy, SF at DAL ($7,000)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.6 DraftKings points at $7,000, the 2nd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.4 points clear of Josh Allen. The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.23 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 15 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 22.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 41.4, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Josh Allen, BUF at NYJ ($7,500)

Josh Allen projects 2nd at the position with 22.2 DraftKings points at $7,500, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.96 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 15 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.3 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 40.8, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is an 8.5-point favorite on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Drew Lock, SEA at LV ($5,000)

Drew Lock projects for 17.3 DraftKings points at $5,000, which works out to 3.46 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 15 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 6.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Lock averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.1 and a ceiling of 32.0, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
